stories.title: Mamata moves Supreme Court against ECI’s freeze on Trinamool Congress symbol

en.title: Mamata moves Supreme Court against ECI's freeze on Trinamool Congress symbol
en.summary: West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee has filed a petition in the Supreme Court challenging the Election Commission's decision to freeze the Trinamool Congress party symbol, citing reliance on statements from rebel legislators facing disqualification proceedings.

stories.title: Trump bans news outlets CNN, MS NOW, Politico from White House

en.title: Trump bans news outlets CNN, MS NOW, Politico from White House
en.summary: President Trump has barred CNN, MS NOW, and Politico from White House access, accusing them of publishing false reports. He indicated that additional news outlets may face similar restrictions if they continue publishing what he characterizes as misleading coverage.

stories.title: "Fiction And Lies": Trump Bans CNN, Politico From White House

en.title: "Fiction And Lies": Trump Bans CNN, Politico From White House
en.summary: President Trump has banned CNN and Politico from White House premises, describing their reporting as fiction and lies, with indications that other news organizations may face comparable exclusion.

stories.title: Donald Trump bans CNN, MSNOW and Politico from White House

en.title: Donald Trump bans CNN, MSNOW and Politico from White House
en.summary: President Trump has prohibited CNN, MSNOW, and Politico from accessing the White House.

stories.title: Coaching centres ‘being threatened’ to keep students away from Rahul Gandhi’s Indore event, alleges Congress

en.title: Coaching centres 'being threatened' to keep students away from Rahul Gandhi's Indore event, alleges Congress
en.summary: Congress alleges that coaching centres are being threatened to prevent students from attending Rahul Gandhi's event in Indore. A Congress official also criticized Madhya Pradesh Police for referencing the Verma Commission report on former Prime Minister Rajiv Gandhi's assassination.

stories.title: Mamata Banerjee Drew Her Party's Symbol By Hand. It's Now Tied To An Indira Gandhi Case

en.title: Mamata Banerjee Drew Her Party's Symbol By Hand. It's Now Tied To An Indira Gandhi Case
en.summary: Mamata Banerjee has lost her party's symbol and name, a decision connected to an Indira Gandhi case. Legal precedents may determine the final outcome of the matter.

stories.title: Nandigram bypoll: Congress candidate Milan Pradhan arrested hours after getting Mamata’s support

en.title: Nandigram bypoll: Congress candidate Milan Pradhan arrested hours after getting Mamata's support
en.summary: Congress candidate Milan Pradhan was arrested shortly after receiving support from Mamata Banerjee for the Nandigram bypoll. Police stated the arrest relates to an older case unconnected to the election.

stories.title: Interests of a political party being served, says Mamata after losing TMC name and symbol; vows to fight back

en.title: Interests of a political party being served, says Mamata after losing TMC name and symbol; vows to fight back
en.summary: Mamata Banerjee claims political interests are being served following her loss of the TMC party name and symbol, and pledges to continue fighting. BJP leaders characterized the outcome as divine intervention.

stories.title: Mamata moves Supreme Court against EC decision to freeze TMC name, symbol

en.title: Mamata moves Supreme Court against EC decision to freeze TMC name, symbol
en.summary: West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee has filed a Supreme Court challenge to the Election Commission's decision to freeze the Trinamool Congress name and symbol for upcoming bypolls, with her faction receiving alternative branding for elections scheduled for October 6.

stories.title: 'Usual BJP formula: Cong slams arrest of Nandigram candidate, Mamata questions timing

en.title: 'Usual BJP formula: Cong slams arrest of Nandigram candidate, Mamata questions timing
en.summary: The Congress party criticized the BJP over an arrest involving a Nandigram candidate, while Mamata Banerjee raised concerns about the timing of the arrest.

stories.title: Bengal hots up: Congress’s Nandigram candidate held after getting Mamata backing

en.title: Bengal hots up: Congress's Nandigram candidate held after getting Mamata backing
en.summary: A Congress candidate for the Nandigram constituency was arrested following Mamata's endorsement, according to reports.

stories.title: 'Dirty game': Cong claims its Nandigram candidate arrested after Mamata extended support

en.title: 'Dirty game': Cong claims its Nandigram candidate arrested after Mamata extended support
en.summary: Congress alleges its Nandigram candidate was arrested following Mamata's support, characterizing the incident as unfair political conduct.

stories.title: French bond spread at highest since 2012 as default insurance spikes

en.title: French bond spread at highest since 2012 as default insurance spikes
en.summary: Risk premiums on French government bonds have reached their highest levels since the eurozone debt crisis as investor concerns mount over France's fiscal health ahead of upcoming elections. France is planning substantial budget-saving measures to address its widening deficit.

stories.title: HDFC MF buys 13.9 lakh Entero Healthcare shares in Rs 236 crore block deal

en.title: HDFC MF buys 13.9 lakh Entero Healthcare shares in Rs 236 crore block deal
en.summary: HDFC Mutual Fund acquired approximately 13.9 lakh shares of Entero Healthcare Solutions for roughly 235.6 crore rupees through a block deal transaction, with the shares representing about 3.19% of the company's equity.

en.summary: Platinum Jasmine is considering selling a 1.7% stake in Lenskart valued at Rs 2,047 crore through a block deal.

en.title: US Federal Reserve's Michelle Bowman says changes to bank stress test coming soon
en.summary: The Federal Reserve plans to vote soon on revamped bank stress tests designed to provide greater transparency and predictability for lenders, with broader capital rule adjustments underway.
